caption: The drawing features three distinct objects arranged on a plain, off-white background. In the upper center is a figure of a person with light skin, black hair, and a black beard and mustache, dressed in a long, deep magenta or burgundy robe with a blue belt and an ornate, frilled white lace collar at the neck. The figure is kneeling, with both hands raised and open in front. Below and to the left is a separate depiction of the same head and upper chest, showing the man's face in profile with similar facial features, hair, and beard, and the same lace collar and magenta garment. To the lower right are two disembodied hands with light skin, emerging from magenta sleeves; the hands are separated from the arms at the forearm. The illustration uses a consistent color palette dominated by shades of magenta, black, white, blue, and light beige. The arrangement of the components appears isolated against the plain backdrop, and each object is presented with clear detail and outlining.
title: Rag Doll
